remarks:
Welcome to this one-of-a-kind custom home on 9+ private agricultural acres in the Wilson School District.
Originally built in 1802 and completely renovated in 2015, this energy-efficient home offers modern comfort with country charm. Features include a chef's kitchen with solid hickory cabinets, granite countertops, farmhouse sink and premium appliances. The open living area boasts a cathedral ceiling, gas fireplace and triple-pane Pella windows. Loft provides office or guest space. Spa-like bath includes heated tile floor, walk-in shower and jetted tub. Primary bedroom features custom built-in storage and opens to a 31'x12' covered deck overlooking the property. Five-zone radiant floor heat, mini-split heat/AC, on-demand hot water, LED lighting, 200-amp service, public water and sewer. Exceptional 64'x42' garage/workshop with heated and air-conditioned work area, office, concrete floor, lean-to, two overhead doors and rear storage. A truly unique property offering privacy, versatility and endless possibilities.
